test_title: PYST 62: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

(1) We knocked across (2) early on Saturday (3) to enjoy (4) the beautiful weather.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. We knocked across .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"We knocked across"** is grammatically incorrect and does not convey a meaningful idea in standard English.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"We came across"** or **"We knocked at"**, depending on the intended meaning.
 
• The rest of the sentence is grammatically correct, making Option 4 the segment with the error.

Correct sentence: *We came across early on Saturday to enjoy the beautiful weather*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Common Errors in Phrasal Verbs:**

 
 
• **Knock at:** Used to describe physically hitting something (e.g., a door).
 
• **Come across:** Used to describe encountering something or someone by chance.
 
• Incorrect usage of phrasal verbs often leads to grammatical errors in sentences.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Context:**
 
 
• Ensure that the chosen phrase or verb aligns with the meaning of the sentence.
 
• Misalignment can render the sentence unclear or incorrect.
